results.name: All assets verified; all fourteen accepted graphics files are byte exact

A single bounded stage follows the eye continuously over ten thousand frames
A different content family uses the shared contract and isolated storage
A hundred allocation/release cycles leave zero owned GPU resources; limits fail before allocation
Thirty mount/unmount cycles release listeners, clocks and resources; duplicate residents are blocked
Missing assets stop before scene creation and preserve clean ownership
A hundred completed recordings release their streams and replaced preview URLs during the scene
Modified required assets fail integrity verification
Pack visits require a saved Observatory handoff before navigation
Explicit Observatory pack arrival leaves the legacy Watershed registry and proof route intact
